editorial.name: Mixpanel
editorial.descriptionZh: 产品分析平台，事件分析、会话回放、实验和功能开关在一个产品里，AI 侧加了会主动报警的 agents、MCP 与 Headless 的 Python 接口。给产品团队看用户行为用。
editorial.takeawayZh: 接上事件流，让 AI 主动报出指标异动
editorial.noteZh: 首屏顶上一条黑底公告写 New Experiments and Feature Flags are now included with Free and Growth plans! 配 Learn More Here。主标题 Build like your customers are right beside you，副题 Know exactly what user behavior is trying to tell you.，两颗深色按钮 Book a Demo / Get Started Free，背景是紫色柱状渐变色块。下面压着一块产品界面示意，标签从左到右是 mixpanel ai、analytics、session replay、experiments、metric trees，第一格里浮着一句 Mixpanel AI detected an unusual 20% drop in signups.。再往下是 Why the best product builders choose Mixpanel，列 Speed and power（自研数据库 Arb）、Contextual AI、Flexible by design、Built to evolve，以及 Your personal analyst, accessible anywhere 讲把 Mixpanel Agent 拖进 Slack 并接 Claude、ChatGPT、Cursor 或任何 MCP 客户端。

reasons.statement: 交付的是对用户行为的度量与反馈：事件分析、会话回放、实验、功能开关，用户来这儿看数据找问题，属行为分析与反馈。
站内 /platform/product-analytics、/platform/session-replay、/platform/experiments、/platform/metric-trees 四页把能力切得很清楚，佐证是分析平台而非测试招募或设计工具。

pages.title: Product Intelligence Platform for the AI Era | Mixpanel
pages.selectionRationale: 本条目采集于 2026-09-15 的首屏实测；手记描述的就是这一屏。

shot.alt: Mixpanel 首屏：Mixpanel is for teams that move. Make your move.

facts.value: Mixpanel AI 主动提示指标异动，示例为 signups 下滑
facts.evidence: 首屏界面示意中的 Mixpanel AI detected an unusual 20% drop in signups.，正文另写 signups dropped 18% week over week, dragging down your Activation KPI

facts.value: AI、Analytics、Session Replay、Experiments、Metric Trees 五个模块
